# Functions catalogue

Every function and procedure in schema `public` of the scratch database (extension-owned objects excluded), one row per signature.

- Signatures: **1263** (1262 distinct names). Security definer: **1060**. Carrying at least one `bosNN` tag in the body: **119**.
- First -> last phase = first and last file, in paste order, that holds a `CREATE [OR REPLACE] FUNCTION <name>(` (by name, so overloads share the span); `unknown` = no such statement in supabase/*.sql (4). Foundation files are `schema`, `phase2..4`, `ALL_NEW`.
- Who may execute = real `EXECUTE` privilege in the scratch DB (`PUBLIC` = granted to everyone). The build gives `anon` and `authenticated` default privileges on new functions (like Supabase), so a function that phases never revoke shows both. `owner/superuser only` = revoked from all API roles.
- Body gates = authorisation calls found by pattern in the function text (`is_owner()`, `has_grant(...)`, `can_do(...)`, `is_active()`, `can_loc(...)`); a function that checks through a helper shows `-`. Heuristic, not a proof.
- Purpose = `COMMENT ON FUNCTION` if present, else the comment lines above the last `CREATE` in the SQL file, else the first comment line of the body; `(no comment)` for 502 signatures.
